delivery.meaning: 仅表示优化智能体已提交并通过必需文件检查，不代表任何光学指标达标。

agent_verdict.reason: Selected candidate-004 (seed_198: 5-group Double Gauss, internal stop, one asphere on the last surface) as the best-evidenced prescription. Matched analysis: EFL 36.02 mm (+2.9% vs exact 35), F/3.655 (+4.4% vs 3.5), FOV 61.55 deg (-2.3%), imgh 21.45 mm exact; geometry physically valid (min vertex spacing 1.17 mm, TTL 64.64, BFL 17.75). Field-resolved image quality is the strongest of the shortlist: polychromatic RMS spot 26.8 / 30.7 / 31.5 um (center/mid/edge, max 39.3) and geometric MTF50 8.8 cyc/mm center, 14.4 / 7.9 cyc/mm edge tan/sag, with internally consistent distortion (-2.1% at edge). No user tolerance is stated for any exact target, so first-order compliance is unknown_tolerance and neither pass nor fail can be asserted; image quality is moderate but has no stated acceptance threshold. Hence uncertain, not pass.
agent_verdict.stop_reason: Plateau reached with no remaining decision-changing hypothesis. Four equal 2500-iteration passes over the seed_198 trajectory drove loss 0.157 -> 0.049 -> 0.041 -> 0.033 -> 0.032; the final block gained only ~4% and traded edge spot (-25%) for a worse F/# (+1.5 pp) instead of improving both. The ~3-4% EFL/F/# residue reproduced independently on the seed_104 retrofocus family (F/3.753, +7.2%), indicating an objective/parameterization coverage limit rather than a seed or topology limit, so another seed or equal-budget re-run has no plausible observable advantage and would be ceremonial.
